# Tomatoes

Grown under glass from seed. Feed weekly once the first truss sets, and
mulch with [[Compost#Hot compost|hot compost]] in June.

## Varieties

- Sungold
  - Sweetest of the lot, splits after heavy rain
- Gardener's Delight
- San Marzano
  - For sauce; needs the warmest spot

## Sowing

![[Planting calendar#April]]

## Problems

> [!warning]- Blight
> Brown patches spreading from the leaf edges. Remove the leaves at once
> and keep the foliage dry. ^blight

Aphids gather on the growing tips; see [[Aphids]].

Yield last year: ~~12 kg~~ 15 kg[^weigh].

![[tomato.svg]]

[^weigh]: Weighed on the kitchen scale, so give or take.
